claims.text: Four scripted agents share one pool that starts at 100 units, over 60 rounds, with a shortage in rounds 20 to 34.
claims.limitation: Scripted request rules, not AI models. Shortage rounds are zero-based 19 to 33 in code.

claims.text: No agent may take more than 4 units a round under the capped designs, and the gated design keeps a 25-unit reserve.
claims.limitation: Rules are applied by the simulation itself.

claims.text: A synthetic scripted test ran 600 paired runs across 200 seeds and three designs.
claims.limitation: Not the earlier unsupported 600-run figure; see CORRECTIONS.md.

claims.text: The gated group retained its reserve in 200/200 runs, compared with 0/200 for both comparison groups.
claims.limitation: True by construction: the gated design cannot grant below the reserve, and the others have no reserve rule.

claims.text: Mean useful work was 591.68 for the gated group, versus 609.72 unrestricted and 609.42 cap-only.
claims.limitation: Useful work is a toy count of units matched to need, not real output.

claims.text: Rules were enforced by construction; live agent behavior, security, social outcomes and human comprehension were not tested.

evidence.equals: scripted synthetic; not live AI or human participants

claims.text: Humans retain release decisions; no gate or score grants real authority.

evidence.source: CLAUDE.md (Z1 proposes, Z2 ratifies) and issue #1329 AUTHORITY_EFFECT=NONE

claims.limitation: Governance rule of this project, not a property of the simulation.

claims.text: Splitting the gated design apart, most of the useful-work cost came from the 25-unit reserve floor (589.22 with reserve alone), not from human consent (613.79 with consent alone); the more even split came from the turn order, not the gate.
claims.limitation: Ablation arms apply rules directly, not via the gate.

claims.text: In the first draft, 2 of 9 checks could not fail; both were rebuilt and now fail when the rule they check is broken.
claims.limitation: Audit by one AI agent, not independent human review.

claims.text: Can AI agents cooperate without taking control?
claims.limitation: This test uses scripted agents, so it cannot answer the question for real AI systems.
